unknown_numeric_policy: A zero in a schema-required fit, wall-hardware or allowance field accompanied by dimensions_status is an UNSELECTED sentinel, not an authorized production dimension. Mode-specific source and interface checks fail closed until named evidence selects them.

requirements.statement: Generate one boundary_crop Berlin example whose positive bodies end at the administrative boundary and one context_outline example whose rectangular field includes Umland and marks Berlin.
requirements.verification: mode manifest, outer-mask containment report, source-coverage report and matched renders

requirements.statement: Each one-off example shall use two permanent main prints, one vertical split, no rear grid and no replaceable section; 600 x 400 mm is fixed for context_outline and a maximum envelope for boundary_crop.
requirements.verification: global bounds, positive-body count, Kobra bed-fit and assembly audit

requirements.statement: Every mode shall use one immutable geospatial frame and split only after global scaling, semantic mapping, outer masking and protected-interface registration.
requirements.verification: source manifest, transform record and cross-seam coordinate report

requirements.statement: context_outline shall fail closed unless a new immutable Berlin/Brandenburg source covers the selected 12 percent default margin on every side.
requirements.verification: projected source bounds contain selected context bounds for every required semantic layer

requirements.statement: Each mode shall use at most four broad Urban Signal filament bodies without dithering; context_outline shall use Orange for the robust Berlin boundary relief.
requirements.source: approved concept v03 and display-mode parameters
requirements.verification: named-body audit, minimum-feature audit, target-slicer tool routing and purge review

requirements.statement: Three concealed loose one-way printed connectors shall permanently join each pair of halves without glue, magnets, screws or a service interface.
requirements.source: approved revision 0.3.0 architecture retained by revision 0.4.0
requirements.verification: mode-specific safe-land placement, interface sections, existing coupon series and physical one-time assembly test

requirements.statement: Two upper local hangers and two lower local standoffs shall lie inside each mode's retained safe body and establish the 18 mm wall plane without a rear frame.
requirements.source: approved isolated mounting architecture and mode-topology correction
requirements.verification: eroded-mask containment, socket ligament report, wall-plane gauge and installed proof test

requirements.statement: Both modes shall reserve optional customer-added rear halo lighting and protected true front-through paths while remaining complete when unlit.
requirements.verification: mode-specific route/keep-out audit, aperture report, passive gauge and human lit/unlit review

requirements.statement: LEDs, wiring, controller, power supply, diffuser, wall screws and wall anchors remain excluded; no electrical or universal wall-load claim is made.
requirements.verification: BOM, installation boundary and release-package review

global_style.summary: Two abstract Berlin readings sharing Urban Signal color logic: a compact administrative silhouette and a rectangular metropolitan context field
global_style.generation_material: four same-family matte PLA colors on a flat-backed printed substrate
global_style.detail_hierarchy: outer-mode identity first, global Berlin registration second, seam-continuous primary routes third, printable secondary detail last

appearance: irregular Berlin silhouette or rectangular Umland field
marked Berlin boundary in context mode
manufacturing: two flat main prints per example

assembly_sequence: Select one display_mode and load its immutable outer mask, source extent and interface-placement manifest.
Print and qualify the existing process-matched connector/standoff coupon on the exact production process.
Regenerate both main halves, rear sockets and cutters from the selected mode skeleton and the recorded winning compensation.
Insert three one-way connectors into the left half, align both halves on a flat fixture and press the right half home once.
Snap two upper hangers and two lower standoffs into the mode-specific rear sockets and verify the 18 mm wall plane.
Optionally add customer lighting only inside declared lands and routes, then install with substrate-appropriate customer-selected hardware.

decision_log.topic: Approve the revision 0.4.0 mode-aware component, source, interface, color and validation decomposition.
decision_log.current_basis: Requirements and concept v03 are human-approved; the guided policy keeps decomposition human-controlled.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Explicit approval of plan/hybrid-design-plan-v0.4.0.json or requested corrections.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the expanded context_outline Berlin/Brandenburg source and derived layers.
decision_log.current_basis: The Berlin-only 0.3.0 PBF does not cover the approved 12 percent context margin.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Immutable transport source, hashes, projected bounds, extraction commands, layer counts and attribution notice.

decision_log.topic: Freeze mode-specific connector, hanger, standoff and LED-route placements.
decision_log.current_basis: Revision 0.3.0 interface shapes remain the shared authority, but their old placements cannot be assumed inside the irregular silhouette.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Inward-offset safe-region solve, ligament sections, symmetry/load-path review and collision-free proxy for both modes.

decision_log.topic: Freeze boundary_crop perimeter simplification and weak-peninsula policy.
decision_log.current_basis: The administrative boundary is appearance-authoritative, while sub-print notches and narrow necks can be mechanically fragile.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Physical-scale deviation report, minimum retained neck/edge-ligament audit and matched outline preview.

decision_log.topic: Freeze mode-specific light-through path sets and rear halo routes.
decision_log.current_basis: Both modes retain light preparation, but perimeter and interface keep-outs differ.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Aperture width/open-area/ligament reports, rear-route coverage and physical light gauge.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the four physical Urban Signal spools and directed transition purge matrix.
decision_log.current_basis: Semantic colors are approved; exact products, batches, measured swatches and opacity remain unrecorded.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Spool/batch records, swatches, opacity notes and exact-profile transition coupon.

decision_log.topic: Select wall-substrate-specific hardware outside the product package.
decision_log.current_basis: Wall substrate and anchors remain installer-specific.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Actual substrate, chosen hardware data and installer-owned proof test.
